name: Klang Valley Double Track Phase 2 (KVDT2)
status_detail: Construction · rehabilitation in progress; full completion targeted end-2027, two years ahead of original schedule
summary: The RM4.475 billion rehabilitation and upgrade of 265 km of KTM track around the Klang Valley: new track, sleepers, signalling and electrification upgrades on the existing double-track network.
why_it_matters: KVDT2 is the quiet workhorse project of valley rail: faster, more reliable KTM services depend on it, and its early completion claim is one of the biggest schedule stories in local transport.
questions_to_follow: Does the end-2027 completion target hold?
Which segments reopen upgraded, and in what order?
location_precision: Corridor-level entry across the KTM network. Marker placed at KL Sentral.

sources.title: KVDT2 upgrade expected to be completed two years ahead of schedule, says KTMB
KVDT2 rehabilitation project to be completed by end-2027

history.event: KTMB announces expected completion two years ahead of original schedule.
